method: Typed into a page in a personal Cosense project, with the caret on another line so it rendered idle. A screenshot of the rendered screen was examined. No developer tools, network traffic, or scripts were inspected. `linkTarget` is absent because it was not observable from the screen. An absent `facts` key means unobserved; `null` means observed and absent. The filler text placed around syntax during observation was replaced with ASCII; the syntax under observation remains as entered.
location: A scratch page in a personal Cosense project, deleted after the observation.

cases.observed: The link colouring covered https://example.com/a]b in full, including the `]` and the `b` after it. The text before it and the text after it stayed plain. The bare URL does not stop at a closing bracket.
